## Episode Thesis

This is a political debate on jobs and business conditions between Benjamin Dousa (M, minister for aid and foreign trade) and Martin Ådahl (C, economic-policy spokesperson), held just before the Swedish election. Topics were unemployment at 8.6%, rising bankruptcies, payroll taxes (allmän löneavgift), karensavdraget and possible government coalitions. No listed companies were discussed as investments. The few company references were an anecdote about Sushi Yama and sponsor ads, so the episode gives no equity signals.
